observations: Photo 0 shows a physical game case for 'Red Dead Redemption II' for the PlayStation 4.
The case is held in front of a 'PREZIN Gadgets' arcade machine.
The case art features a cowboy holding a revolver.
The PlayStation 4 logo is visible at the top of the case.
The PEGI 18 rating is visible on the bottom left of the case.
A watermark 'PREZIN GADGETS' is overlaid on the image.

The case is shown, but the presence of a second disc is not confirmed.
The title 'Red Dead Redemption II' is clearly printed on the case in photo 0.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.
